scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/shared-infra && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/hanet-client && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/error-mapping
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/api && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/worker && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/hanet-mock
scripts.clean: find . -name 'dist' -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete 2>/dev/null; echo 'clean done'
